title: Easing primitives and composed programs
teaches: Named eases, steps, cubic-bezier, seq, spring and chain all compile into the same program table. The key value still lands exactly on the key tick; the program only shapes the interior of the segment.
observe: linear, smoothstep, in-out-cubic and out-expo sample differently at u = 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75.
hold keeps the previous value until the end key; steps with n 2 separates jump end from jump start at u = 0.25 and 0.75.
seq overshoots past 1.15, spring oscillates, and chain quantizes a bezier.
